## Goal: Test stress-response and amino-acid-metabolism in TCGA data

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import wilcoxon, mannwhitneyu, kruskal
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
from scipy.stats import spearmanr, rankdata
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
from statsmodels.stats.outliers_influence import variance_inflation_factor
```

```{python}
data_filtered = pd.read_csv("data_filtered.csv", index_col=0)
genes_metadata = pd.read_csv("tcga_brca_gene_metadata.csv",index_col=0)
meta_sub = pd.read_csv("sample_metadata_with_subtype.csv",index_col=1)
data_paired = pd.read_csv("data_paired.csv",index_col=0)
```

```{python}
# Map Ensembl IDs to gene symbols 
data_filtered["gene_symbol"] = data_filtered.index.map(genes_metadata["gene_name"])
data_filtered = data_filtered.dropna(subset=["gene_symbol"])
data_filtered = data_filtered.drop_duplicates(subset="gene_symbol", keep="first")
data_filtered = data_filtered.set_index("gene_symbol")
```

```{python}
cpm_all = data_filtered.div(data_filtered.sum(axis=0), axis=1) * 1e6
logcpm_all = np.log2(cpm_all + 1)

tum = meta_sub[(meta_sub["tcga.cgc_sample_sample_type"] == "Primary Tumor") &
               meta_sub["BRCA_Subtype_PAM50"].isin(["Basal", "Her2", "LumA", "LumB"])]
```

### check if ranking replicates in TCGA

```{python}
def zmean(genes, mat):
    g = [x for x in genes if x in mat.index]
    e = mat.loc[g]
    return e.sub(e.mean(axis=1), axis=0).div(e.std(axis=1), axis=0).mean(axis=0)

ids = tum.index[tum["BRCA_Subtype_PAM50"] == "Basal"]
ids = ids[ids.isin(logcpm_all.columns)]
X = logcpm_all.loc[:, ids]
X = X[(X.mean(axis=1) > 1) & (X.std(axis=1) > 0)]          # drop barely expressed genes
print("Basal tumors:", len(ids), "| genes kept:", X.shape[0])

ser = zmean(["PHGDH", "PSAT1", "PSPH"], logcpm_all.loc[:, ids]).values
pro = zmean(["MKI67", "TOP2A", "MCM2", "PCNA", "CCNB1", "AURKA", "BIRC5", "CDK1"], logcpm_all.loc[:, ids]).values

A = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(pro)), pro])
proj = A @ np.linalg.inv(A.T @ A) @ A.T
G = X.values
G_res = G - G @ proj                                         # remove proliferation from every gene
s_res = ser - proj @ ser                                      # and from the serine score

Rg = np.apply_along_axis(rankdata, 1, G_res)
Rs = rankdata(s_res)
Rg = (Rg - Rg.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)) / Rg.std(axis=1, keepdims=True)
Rs = (Rs - Rs.mean()) / Rs.std()
rho_tcga = pd.Series((Rg * Rs).mean(axis=1), index=X.index)
rho_tcga = rho_tcga.drop(["PHGDH", "PSAT1", "PSPH"], errors="ignore")

print("\nTCGA top 25:"); print(rho_tcga.sort_values(ascending=False).head(25).round(2))

key = ["ASNS", "SHMT2", "CHAC1", "ATF4", "GPT2", "MTHFD2", "CBS", "ISYNA1", "MTHFD1L", "SFXN1", "SFXN2", "MKI67"]
print("\nKey genes, TCGA partial rho:"); print(rho_tcga.reindex(key).round(2))

scanb = pd.read_csv("scanb_basal_serine_partial_rho.csv").set_index("gene")["partial_rho"]
both = pd.concat([scanb.rename("scanb"), rho_tcga.rename("tcga")], axis=1).dropna()
r, p = spearmanr(both["scanb"], both["tcga"])
print(f"\nGenes in both: {len(both)} | agreement across the whole ranking: rho = {r:.2f}")
top = both["scanb"].sort_values(ascending=False).head(40).index
print("Of the SCAN-B top 40, positive in TCGA:", int((both.loc[top, 'tcga'] > 0).sum()),
      "| above 0.2 in TCGA:", int((both.loc[top, 'tcga'] > 0.2).sum()))
```

Within Basal-like tumors, serine synthesis expression tracked an amino-acid stress-response program (ASNS, CHAC1, TRIB3, SHMT2, MTHFD2, and aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases) after removing proliferation, in both SCAN-B (n = 360) and TCGA (n = 197).
